analysis_summary: This ontology models the multi-actor dynamics of Indian politics to simulate scenarios where national opposition like the INC diminishes and single-party dominance or regional pushback emerges. By specifying political parties, leaders, coalitions, state agencies, media outlets, and grassroots groups, alongside fallbacks, the system can realistically track cross-platform political discourse, state responses, and regional balance-of-power shifts over a five-year horizon.
simulation_requirement: What will happen in an ideal scenario if INC, Indian National Congress, would be diluted and it's totally diminished, and only BJP remains in the power, in the politics for India? How would the things turn out in next 5 years for the Government of India?
